visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with brown hair and bangs wearing a light beige hoodie. She stands in a bright, white-walled bedroom with a bed behind her covered in a white and grey checkered comforter. Her mouth moves and she uses frequent hand gestures, pointing at the camera and touching her hair. (2) A sharp cut leads to a wide outdoor shot of a snowy slope where a figure in a grey ski suit and white helmet raises their arms in a cheer. Several other skiers are visible in the background along with a ski lift and snow-covered trees. (3) Returning to the bedroom, the woman holds up a thin black fabric shirt, stretching it with both hands to show its transparency and texture. (4) A still photograph of her in a grey ski jacket outdoors is displayed, followed by another photo of her indoors in a black top. (5) She presents a grey zippered rectangular bag, placing it on the bed and opening it to reveal folded clothes. She pulls out pairs of ski gloves—one blue and grey, one solid grey—and holds them close to the lens. (6) She holds up long grey socks with white and blue patterns, demonstrating their length by stretching them vertically. (7) An overhead shot shows five knit beanies in brown, black, navy, and yellow colors arranged on the checkered bed. She picks up the yellow beanie and rotates it. (8) She shows a black sunglasses case, puts on large round black sunglasses, and then demonstrates a pair of prescription glasses with a magnetic clip-on sunglass layer. (9) She displays a large pair of ski goggles with a blue mirrored lens and a black strap, turning them to show the interior foam and the orange tint of the lens. (10) She pulls a grey fabric gaiter over her head, covering her neck and lower face, then puts on her sunglasses to demonstrate full coverage. She finishes by waving her right hand at the camera.
